title: Compile against the declared Java contract
summary: Use javac as authoritative syntax/type evidence. The FederationBank Java ATM harness compiles main and test source with `javac --release 17 -Xlint:all` and runs with `java -ea`; do not silently compile against whatever source/target level the host defaults to.
correct: Declare the intended Java release when the project does.
Use the actual project classpath/sourcepath rather than inventing missing APIs.
Treat unresolved optional dependencies as dependency evidence, not as proof the Java source is wrong.
